# OtakuStream - LLM Codebase Guide

This file gives AI coding assistants and future maintainers a compact understanding of the OtakuStream repository.

## Project summary

OtakuStream is a Flutter/Dart reader app for novels, manga, and anime-style content. The current app is centered on WTR API-powered novel discovery and reading, with foundations for manga reading, anime/video playback, extensions, and settings.

The long-term architecture should be source-agnostic: UI screens should depend on common models and source interfaces, not directly on one provider API.

## Environment

- Flutter SDK: `>=3.4.0 <4.0.0`
- Package name: `otaku_stream`
- App version: `1.0.0+1`

## Main dependencies

- `dio`, `http` - API requests
- `shared_preferences` - local settings and future selected source storage
- `logger` - debug logging
- `google_nav_bar` - bottom navigation
- `adaptive_theme` - light/dark/system theme
- `responsive_framework` - responsive breakpoints
- `dns_client` - custom DNS resolver support
- `cloudflare_bypass`, `cloudflare_interceptor` - protected source handling
- `dart_web_scraper` - scraping-based source support
- `cached_network_image`, `flutter_cache_manager` - image loading/cache
- `photo_view` - manga/image viewing
- `chewie`, `video_player` - anime/video playback

## Current entry points

- `lib/main.dart`
  - Initializes Flutter.
  - Runs `OtakuStreamApp`.

- `lib/src/app.dart`
  - Defines the main app widget.
  - Configures theme and responsive behavior.
  - Routes into the splash/home flow.

## Important current areas

- `lib/src/core/constants/api_constants.dart`
  - WTR base URLs and endpoint paths.

- `lib/src/core/network/`
  - Central networking helpers and Dio client logic.

- `lib/src/features/home/`
  - Home feed and bottom navigation shell.

- `lib/src/features/search/`
  - Search UI and repository logic.

- `lib/src/features/details/`
  - Novel details model, repository, and screen.

- `lib/src/features/chapter_list/`
  - Chapter list model and screen.

- `lib/src/features/reader/`
  - Novel reader, manga reader, anime player, reader models, and repository.

- `lib/src/features/extensions/`
  - Extension/source selection UI foundation.

- `lib/src/features/settings/`
  - Settings UI foundation.

- `lib/src/features/books/`
  - Shared/current book model area.

## Current API constants

```dart
webBaseUrl = 'https://wtr-lab.com'
apiProxyBaseUrl = 'https://cors-bypasser-pro.vercel.app/proxy?url=https://wtr-lab.com'
serieRanking = '/api/serie/ranking'
search = '/api/search'
novelDetails = '/api/novel/details'
chapterList = '/api/novel/chapters'
readerGet = '/api/reader/get'
```

## Desired architecture

Move gradually toward this source-driven structure:

```txt
lib/src/
├── core/
│   ├── constants/
│   ├── network/
│   ├── storage/
│   └── utils/
├── extensions/
│   ├── models/
│   │   ├── content_item.dart
│   │   ├── content_details.dart
│   │   ├── chapter_item.dart
│   │   └── content_source.dart
│   ├── registry/
│   │   └── source_registry.dart
│   ├── novel/
│   │   └── wtr_novel_source.dart
│   ├── manga/
│   │   └── manga_source.dart
│   └── anime/
│       └── anime_source.dart
├── features/
│   ├── home/
│   ├── search/
│   ├── details/
│   ├── chapter_list/
│   ├── reader/
│   ├── extensions/
│   └── settings/
└── app.dart
```

## Core design rule

Do not hardcode source-specific API logic inside UI widgets.

Bad:

```dart
HomePage -> directly calls WTR endpoint
```

Good:

```dart
HomePage -> activeSource.getHome()
```

## Planned common source interface

```dart
abstract class ContentSource {
  String get id;
  String get name;
  String get type;
  String get baseUrl;

  Future<List<ContentItem>> getHome();
  Future<List<ContentItem>> search(String query);
  Future<ContentDetails> getDetails(String id);
  Future<List<ChapterItem>> getChapters(String id);
}
```

## Planned common models

### ContentItem

Generic item for Home/Search lists.

Suggested fields:

- `id`
- `title`
- `imageUrl`
- `subtitle`
- `type`
- `sourceId`
- `extra`

### ContentDetails

Generic details data.

Suggested fields:

- `id`
- `title`
- `imageUrl`
- `description`
- `author`
- `status`
- `genres`
- `type`
- `sourceId`
- `extra`

### ChapterItem

Generic chapter/episode/page-group item.

Suggested fields:

- `id`
- `title`
- `number`
- `url`
- `type`
- `sourceId`
- `extra`

## Source registry behavior

The future source registry should:

- Return all available sources.
- Return source by ID.
- Return a default source.
- Load selected source ID from preferences.
- Save selected source ID to preferences.

## Navigation plan

Main bottom tabs:

```txt
Home
Search
Extensions
Settings
```

Details, Chapter List, Reader, Manga Reader, and Anime Player should be pushed screens, not bottom tabs.

## Extension behavior

When a user selects an extension/source:

1. Save selected source ID in SharedPreferences.
2. Update active source in app state.
3. Refresh Home using the selected source.
4. Search uses the selected source.
5. Details, Chapter List, Reader, Manga Reader, or Anime Player use the selected source/content type.

## Networking rules

- Use `DioClient` or the existing repository networking pattern for API requests.
- Keep source-specific headers inside source/repository classes.
- Log network and parser errors using `Logger`.
- Keep Cloudflare-specific logic isolated.
- Keep scraping logic isolated inside source/extension classes.
- Do not expose secrets, tokens, private keys, or hidden credentials.

## UI rules

- Home/Search should display generic content items.
- Details should display generic details data.
- Chapter List should display generic chapter/episode items.
- Reader/Player should branch by content type only at the final rendering layer.
- Preserve existing working UI while migrating architecture gradually.

## Settings feature direction

Settings should eventually include:

- Theme mode: light/dark/system
- DNS resolver selection/test
- GitHub link
- Issue report link
- Contact link
- About app
- App version/developer info

## DNS resolver direction

DNS resolver logic should live in a service such as:

```txt
lib/src/core/network/dns_resolver_service.dart
```

Settings UI should call service methods instead of implementing resolver logic directly.

## Development order recommendation

1. Add common models.
2. Add `ContentSource` interface.
3. Convert current WTR novel API into `WtrNovelSource`.
4. Add `SourceRegistry`.
5. Add `PrefsService`.
6. Update Home to use active source.
7. Update Search to use active source.
8. Update Details and Chapter List to use active source.
9. Connect Reader/Manga Reader/Anime Player by content type.
10. Expand Extensions tab.
11. Expand Settings tab.
12. Add DNS resolver service.
13. Add manga source.
14. Add anime source.

## Constraints for AI assistants

- Do not rewrite the whole app unless explicitly asked.
- Provide complete file contents when modifying code.
- Always mention exact file paths in explanations.
- Keep code compatible with Flutter SDK `>=3.4.0 <4.0.0`.
- Keep imports clean and consistent with the project style.
- Prefer simple working code over over-engineered abstractions.
- Preserve demo fallback behavior unless asked to remove it.
- Do not hardcode new provider APIs into UI screens.
- Do not mix DNS, Cloudflare, scraping, or parser logic into presentation widgets.
